description: PS1 semi-transparent textures dumped from Beetle PSX HW (hash-named, no mode tag). Region-aware tri-state snap to exactly 0 / 127 / 255: Beetle uses 127 (true 50%) for semi-transparent pixels. Flat semi surfaces keep 127; upscaled cutout edges go binary. Safe for binary Beetle textures too — with no flat semi surfaces the result comes out clean 0 / 255. Preserves existing alpha, no blur. Touches the alpha channel only — enable Edge dilation manually if you want RGB bled into the cut-outs to suppress halos.
